# Echoras

> Echoras transforms music into a physical 3D-printed object — a sound sculpture generated from an audio file, designed to be collected, displayed or given as a gift.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://echoras.dedyn.io/): Overview, how-it-works steps, and gallery of example sculptures
- [Studio 3D — Creator](https://echoras.dedyn.io/createur): Interactive 3D editor — upload audio, customize shape/relief/dimensions, preview the sculpture
- [Gallery](https://echoras.dedyn.io/galerie): Collection of sculptures created by Echoras users
- [How it works](https://echoras.dedyn.io/comment-ca-marche): Step-by-step guide (upload → customize → receive)
- [FAQ](https://echoras.dedyn.io/faq): Questions about materials, pricing, delivery times, and data privacy
- [Contact](https://echoras.dedyn.io/contact): Contact form for support and inquiries

## Materials

- [Materials & pricing](https://echoras.dedyn.io/comment-ca-marche): Matte plastic (PLA), metal (silver/gold), resin, wood, ceramic — each with its own price tier

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://echoras.dedyn.io/confidentialite): GDPR-compliant data handling, cookie consent (tarteaucitron)
- [Legal notice](https://echoras.dedyn.io/mentions-legales): Legal information about the company
